map.FPY = 一次合格数 ÷ 总生产数 × 100%。一次合格指无需任何返工/返修: FPY = first-time-good units ÷ total produced units × 100%. First-time-good means units that pass without any rework/repair; if a unit passes after repair, it is not counted as 'first-time-good'.
map.某工序当日投产 1000 件，其中 950 件一次合格、50 件经返修后合格：F: A process started 1000 units that day, of which 950 passed first time and 50 passed after rework: FPY = 950 ÷ 1000 × 100% = 95.00%. Although the final yield is 100%, FPY is only 95%, indicating 5% rework waste; the root cause of those 50 units should be traced rather than only looking at final shipment.
map.FPY 和最终合格率有何不同？: What is the difference between FPY and final yield?
map.最终合格率包含返修后合格品，掩盖了返工成本；FPY 只承认首次合格的单元，能更真: Final yield includes units passing after rework, masking rework cost; FPY only counts first-time-good units, more truthfully exposing process variation and waste, and is the metric Six Sigma values more.
map.FPY 低但合格率 100% 要不要管？: Should FPY be low but yield 100% be addressed?
map.要管。FPY 低意味着持续返工，带来人力、工时、设备占用与潜在质量风险；长期看会: Yes. Low FPY means persistent rework, bringing labor, hours, equipment occupation and potential quality risk; in the long run it erodes delivery and cost, and should be an improvement focus rather than ignored because of 'final pass'.
map.一次通过率 FPY = 良品数 ÷ 投入数 × 100%；不良品数 = 投入数: First pass yield FPY = good units ÷ input units × 100%; defective units = input units − good units; DPPM = defective units ÷ input units × 10⁶ (parts per million, with the denominator floored at 1e−9); decimal form = good units ÷ input units. Validation: good units and input units are both required valid numbers. Criteria: the closer FPY is to 100%, the stronger the process's first-pass capability.
map.一次通过率 FPY = 首次合格数 ÷ 投入数 × 100%；未一次通过数量 =: FPY = first-pass good units ÷ input units × 100%; not-first-pass quantity = input units − first-pass good units; not-first-pass parts per million = not-first-pass quantity ÷ input units × 10⁶. Validation: both counts are non-negative integers, input >0, and first-pass good units ≤ input. Definition: first-pass good excludes reworked units; the not-first-pass quantity is neither a defect count nor a final scrap count.
map.首次即合格、不含返修后合格的比例；未一次通过数量按件计，与缺陷数、最终报废数不同: Share passing first time without rework; the not-first-pass quantity is counted in units and differs from defect count and final scrap.
map.FPY = 首次合格数 ÷ 投入数 × 100%；未一次通过数量 = 投入数 −: FPY = first-pass good units ÷ input units × 100%; not-first-pass quantity = input − first-pass good; not-first-pass ppm = not-first-pass quantity ÷ input × 10⁶. Both counts must be non-negative integers, input >0, and first-pass good ≤ input. First-pass good excludes reworked units.

FPY=950÷1000×100%=95.00%; not-first-pass quantity=50 units; not-first-pass ppm=50,000 DPPM. Final yield may be 100%, but that does not mean zero defects or zero scrap; the definitions differ.
